<script>
(function(){
  var bar=document.querySelector('.pf-bar'); if(!bar) return;
  var sels=[].slice.call(bar.querySelectorAll('select')), cards=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.pc-grid .pc'));
  var count=bar.querySelector('.pf-count'), empty=document.querySelector('.pf-empty');
  function apply(){
    var n=0;
    cards.forEach(function(c){
      var ok=sels.every(function(s){
        var v=s.value; if(!v) return true;
        var k=s.getAttribute('data-filter'), d=c.getAttribute('data-'+k)||'';
        var parts = k==='years' ? d.split(' ') : d.split('|');
        return parts.indexOf(v)>-1;
      });
      c.hidden=!ok; if(ok) n++;
    });
    count.textContent = n + (n===1?' project':' projects');
    if(empty) empty.hidden = n>0;
  }
  sels.forEach(function(s){ s.addEventListener('change', apply); });
  bar.querySelector('.pf-reset').addEventListener('click', function(){ sels.forEach(function(s){ s.value=''; }); apply(); });
  apply();
})();
</script>
